title: Owner-Authorized Private Audio Delete Lifecycle
goal: Delete one owner-authorized private audio asset without ever leaving the canonical project graph pointing at removed private audio.
ordering: authorize authenticated Sesh project owner for write
conditionally detach audio asset id from project graph

failurePolicy.projectCasFailure: stop before destructive metadata or R2 deletion
failurePolicy.metadataDeleteFailureAfterDetach: return unavailable and retain binary for recoverability
failurePolicy.r2DeleteFailureAfterMetadataDelete: return unavailable and surface orphan cleanup risk without restoring project reference
